title: Ich sehe das anders
desc: Disagreeing without it becoming about a person
setting: A club meeting on a Tuesday, eleven people, six hundred francs and forty minutes.

steps.speaker: Ein Mann vom Vorstand
steps.es: Also machen wir das so. Sind alle einverstanden?
steps.en: So we will do it that way. Is everybody agreed?

options.feedback: Four words, very calm. They attack nobody and give up nothing, and the room will make space.
Put flat on the table it decides for everybody. Watch what the room does with it.

options.es: Ich weiss nicht, ob ich das gut finde.
options.en: I do not know whether I think that is good.
options.feedback: Honest and shapeless. Say what you see and let them answer it.

options.es: Mir scheint, das kostet uns nächstes Jahr mehr.
options.en: It seems to me that will cost us more next year.
options.feedback: An opening that says this is mine, and then a reason with a number in it.

options.es: Weil es einfach keinen Sinn macht.
options.en: Because it simply makes no sense.
options.feedback: Einfach and no reason. That is the sentence that ends a discussion and wins nothing.

options.es: Das habe ich vorhin doch gesagt.
options.feedback: Doch in the middle, at somebody who is chairing. It reads as a complaint about him.

steps.speaker: Margrit
steps.es: Da hat er recht. Das haben wir letztes Jahr auch gehabt.
steps.en: He is right there. We had that last year too.

options.feedback: She has just supported you without meaning to. One syllable takes it and moves on.

options.en: Exactly, that is what I mean.
options.feedback: Fine and a bit eager. Ja in there makes it sound like you were waiting.
Thanking somebody for agreeing turns a matter into two sides with members.
You will probably lose and it will be over. Whoever loses often writes the minutes.

options.es: Können wir noch einmal darüber reden?
options.en: Can we talk about it again?
options.feedback: You have said it. A second round is where a matter starts turning into a person.

options.es: Ich bin dagegen, das ist klar.
options.en: I am against it, that is clear.
options.feedback: They know. Saying it again just before the vote adds nothing.
